text:
Tess Ramirez: Quick design catch from today's usability pass on the routing editor: the compact rule rows in the canvas are overlapping the priority handle hit area when the sidebar is narrow. Users are missing the grab affordance. Amir Khan: repro steps? which browser/zoom? Tess Ramirez: open Policies > shrink window to 1/3 width > create 4 rules > try drag handle. Happens in Chrome and FF at 125% zoom. Laura Chen: I noticed the same when testing on a 13" laptop. The handle is visually centered but the interactive area is shifted. Might be a flexbox overflow issue. Priya Desai: Accessibility note: keyboard users rely on the whole row being reachable. If hit area is small it breaks discoverability. Amir Khan: Possible quick fix: increase padding on the handle container to 12px and expand :focus-visible outline. Also add a secondary "Move to top" action in the kebab menu for long lists. Tess Ramirez: Love the move-to-top idea for long rule stacks. Saves repeated key presses. For copy, current validation shows: "Rule conflict" which is terse and not helpful. Suggest: "Two rules match the same input. Either change the order or narrow one rule's matcher." Priya Desai: +1. Also propose an inline help link: "Learn about rule precedence" that opens the docs in a new tab. design-bot: Accessibility scan: focusable regions smaller than 24px flagged. Recommend min target size 32px for interactive controls. Amir Khan: For the simulation preview: UX inconsistency — the preview toast shows a heatmap then disappears; users want a persistent breakdown (success/fail counts, average latency) to copy or inspect. Transient toasts aren't great for screen reader or keyboard navigation. Laura Chen: Agreed. Could we create a sticky simulation summary panel anchored to the right of the editor while a simulation runs + a compact summary after it finishes? That would keep results in DOM order and avoid live-region timing issues. Tess Ramirez: Implementation sketch: show a small panel with aria-live="polite" that updates progress. On finish append a summary with role="status" and a dismiss button. If sim errors, flip to aria-live="assertive" for the error message. Amir Khan: Pseudocode for the sr-only progress updates: ```html
Simulation started
Sim complete: 24 requests; 1 error
``` Priya Desai: Small animation nit: when the right panel animates in we lose keyboard focus sometimes. Can we reduce the entrance animation or use transform-only animations to keep focus stable? Amir Khan: I'll switch to a 120ms transform-only animation and ensure focus is set to the summary panel on open. Tess Ramirez: Also think about adding a permanent small icon on each rule row indicating whether a rule is covered by the last simulation (hit count). Hover shows exact count. That helps users correlate rules <> traffic. Laura Chen: Good idea. UX copy for the tooltip: "Matched X times in last simulation". Keep it short. Priya Desai: Test plan additions: NVDA + VoiceOver run-through, keyboard-only reorder (grab via space, arrow moves), and tab sequence when simulation starts/finishes. Amir Khan: Action list: - Amir: expand handle hit area + focus style + move-to-top menu item (branch: ux/expand-handle) (ETA: today) - Amir: implement sticky sim summary panel w/ polite live updates and assertive on errors (ETA: this sprint) - Design (Tess/Laura): update validation copy and add docs link (ETA: next design pass) - Priya: add a11y checks to the card acceptance criteria and run smoke tests after PR. Tess Ramirez: I'll drop a sketch in Figma and add the compact summary states. Link: https://redwood-designs.internal/figma/routing-sim-summary Laura Chen: Please tag me on PRs. Also remind QA to test on small viewports. Priya Desai: I'll queue the accessibility checklist and request review once Amir posts a PR. Amir Khan: Uploaded a short recording showing the handle hitbox issue to the PR: https://redwood-internal.s3/handle-hitbox.webm Tess Ramirez: Thanks all. These are small layout & copy fixes but reduce confusion a lot. :seedling:
